# Marshall Elliott

## Overview

- **Age:** About fifty  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P30](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0030), [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032)</sub>

## Appearance

For fifteen years, Marshall Elliott appeared as an eccentric, dime-museum freak with extremely long hair and a long beard, resembling an ancient Viking. After shaving his beard and cutting his hair, he was revealed to be a handsome, middle-aged man with a strong, clean-shaven chin.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P24](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0024)_

## Personality

Marshall is a determined, stubborn, and passionate man with a bit of a temper. A fiery Grit in his political views, he possesses a strong sense of humor and enjoys a good joke. He is also a great lover of dancing and possesses a fine tenor singing voice.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P27](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0027), [v4 c37 P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017)_

## Goals

- Refusing to cut his hair or shave until the Liberal party won office  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)</sub>

## History

During a particularly bitter general election fifteen years earlier, Marshall Elliott publicly vowed never to cut his hair or shave his face until the Liberal (Grit) party came to power. Because the Liberals remained out of office, he faithfully kept his vow for fifteen years, giving him an unusually shaggy, freakish appearance. During this time, he spent time with Captain Jim, going cod-fishing, singing old ballads, and dancing rhythmically at social gatherings around Four Winds. When the election results finally brought the Liberals to power, Marshall quietly walked to Augustus Palmer's barber shop late at night, forced the sleeping barber to open the shop, and had his hair and beard trimmed under the condition that political matters were not discussed. Shortly after changing his appearance, he met Anne Shirley at the lighthouse, silently enjoying the joke that she failed to recognize him. Later that summer, Marshall became engaged to Miss Cornelia Bryant and agreed to live at her property after their wedding.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P24](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0024), [v4 c35 P27](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0027), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c35 P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032), [v4 c37 P8](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0008), [v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009), [v4 c37 P14](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0014)_
